opening: My stools have recently been black, like coal.

opening.text: I've got some pain, and my stools have recently been black, like coal. I also get a burning feeling that starts in my stomach and goes up into my throat, sometimes with a bitter taste in my mouth. My symptoms get worse after I eat. I smoke cigarettes, and I drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.
